name: @qf-jarvis/aarohi-agent
description: QF Jarvis Aarohi AVG-1..AVG-12 offline DOMAIN (ADR-0085/0111/0112/0113/0122/0123/0124/0125/0126/0127/0128/0130, QVGE overlay). The Jarvis-side domain contract for genuinely net-new, UNREGISTERED vendor acquisition: an opaque prospect identity that is explicitly NOT a Core vendor identity, a closed acquisition-case lifecycle describing Aarohi's own work rather than the party's business state, a fail-closed existing-vendor gate whose permitted set is exactly one Core status, and the ACTIVE handoff BOUNDARY that trusts QuickFurno Core alone. AVG-5 adds an offline Instagram conversation domain: inbound messages are bounded, normalized, never-interpreted OBSERVATIONS stamped INJECTED_OFFLINE_INSTAGRAM_OBSERVATION; the conversation snapshot is immutable, finite, deduplicated and canonically ordered with no outbound turn direction; and an outbound CANDIDATE is derived only from a canonical AVG-4 OPEN draft after the current Core gate is re-run, stating as literal falsehoods that no communication request, approval request, approval decision, communication authorization or execution intent was created and that nothing was sent or delivered. The Instagram token is Aarohi-local; the shared governed channel vocabulary is unchanged and still excludes Instagram, because adopting an executable Instagram channel belongs to the later QFJ-P09 execution integration. AVG-6 adds cross-channel identity as EVIDENCE and never as a rewrite: claims say only that an observation supports or contradicts two channel-local handles being one party, the bundle is immutable, capped, deduplicated and canonically ordered by the semantic UTC instant with a public parser that certifies the whole aggregate, and the deterministic policy recommends a link only on two independent corroborating legs with no contradiction, and refuses a recommendation whose own instant precedes the latest evidence it names. There is no merge function and no field that could record one. A WhatsApp participant reference and a sourceRef are opaque channel-local handles screened by an opaque character class, contact shapes and a count of digits anywhere in the reference, so no phone number or other destination enters the package under any punctuation. The WhatsApp CHANNEL handoff candidate is not the Anisha OWNERSHIP handoff: it transitions no acquisition case, never reaches completeCoreActiveHandoff, binds a canonical AVG-5 conversation and the canonical evidence bundle, RE-DERIVES the recommendation from that bundle and requires an exact match before acting on it, re-runs the current Core gate, and states that Core must still resolve the recipient, revalidate consent and revalidate eligibility at execution time. AVG-7 adds the SALES BRAIN as behaviour and never as a message: a strict, closed, model-SHAPED interpretation is INJECTED offline and bound to the exact current inbound turn of an AVG-5-certified conversation, which the caller cannot name; a stale reading is refused once a newer turn exists; the causal chain message -> reading -> plan is checked as semantic UTC instants; the current Core gate is re-run and only NOT_REGISTERED proceeds; and a deterministic total policy over two closed vocabularies returns a reply BRIEF, never a reply. A rejection or contact-privacy signal outranks selling from either vocabulary, including on a mixed commercial signal, and stops local sales drafting without claiming anything about consent. Commercial questions stop at Core commercial context and registration/payment/activation questions at Core process context, so no price, package, discount, offer, registration, payment or activation claim originates in the brain. References carry two roles: bindings inherited from certified AVG-1 and AVG-5 artifacts keep the upstream opaque grammar untouched, because a downstream stage may not narrow a grammar it does not own, while AVG-7's own interpretationRef and planRef additionally refuse contact shapes and seven or more digits anywhere. Every sales-ethics prohibition -- commitment, commercial truth, price, discount, lead-volume/revenue/conversion guarantees, invented urgency, invented scarcity, unsupported social proof, hidden material package limitation and contractual commitment -- is a schema-pinned literal false, as are model call, prompt resolution and retrieval: QF Model Gateway and Prompt Registry remain the sole future waists and neither is imported or depended on here. AVG-8 carries COMMERCIAL TRUTH as Core reference data and never as a value Aarohi originates: it mirrors QuickFurno's available-package READ contract exactly -- the seven fields that service exposes, in Core's own names -- and deliberately does not reach behind it for price_per_lead or created_at, nor calculate a per-lead figure from the two prices it does carry. total_price and display_price are preserved separately and exactly in all three directions, with nothing subtracted, divided or named a discount. Selection is identifier lookup only: the whole available catalog or one exact package id, with no cheapest, best-value or recommended, no budget or optimisation input, and no fallback when an id is absent; canonical order is by package id, which is serialization and provably not a ranking. A brief RE-DERIVES the AVG-7 plan it rests on through AVG-7's own evaluator and requires an exact field-for-field reproduction, so the current Core gate, the latest-turn binding and the causal chain all carry across, and only an honestly re-derived REQUEST_CORE_COMMERCIAL_CONTEXT proceeds against a catalog observed no earlier than the plan. The result is a closed structured fact brief with no explanation, summary or reply field, declaring snapshotSourceAuthenticated false and requiring Core commercial revalidation before any future outbound use. AVG-9 adds REGISTRATION INTEGRATION as assistance and never as registration: QuickFurno Core exposes a registration WRITE and no registration-process READ contract, so this stage mirrors nothing and invents nothing -- it carries a closed availability token and an OPAQUE reference to Core-authored process material, and holds no step, requirement, document list, endpoint or duration. A brief RE-DERIVES the AVG-7 plan it rests on through AVG-7's own evaluator and requires a structural, key-for-key reproduction rather than an enumerated field list, so a governed field added to AVG-7 later is compared rather than ignored; the current Core gate, the latest-turn binding and the causal chain all carry across, and AVG-7's own refusal is surfaced rather than flattened. Only an honestly re-derived REQUEST_CORE_PROCESS_CONTEXT whose intent is REGISTRATION_PROCESS proceeds, because PAYMENT_OR_ACTIVATION reaches the same strategy and belongs to AVG-10. The process context is bound to the prospect and to the Core lookup the gate ran under, must be observed no earlier than the plan that asked for it, and has no fallback when Core holds none. The result is an inert brief with no explanation, instruction, guidance or script field, declaring processContextSourceAuthenticated false, registrationProcessInvented false, marketplaceMutated false and acquisitionCaseMutated false, and requiring Core registration execution and current Core status revalidation before any future outbound use. AVG-10 adds PAYMENT FOLLOW-UP and the ANISHA HANDOFF boundary, and its whole shape is the insistence that payment is not activation. QuickFurno exposes a registration and payment WRITE path and no prospect-facing payment or activation READ: every per-party read is keyed by a Core vendor id Aarohi structurally does not hold, the order lifecycle columns are unconstrained free text whose only writer sets not_started and not_activated over a provider the same row calls not_connected, and Core vendor status has no ACTIVE member at all. So nothing is mirrored and no payment lifecycle is invented -- a closed availability token and one OPAQUE reference, with no amount, currency, order, transaction, provider, method or status anywhere, and the only number in a brief is its contract version. A brief RE-DERIVES the AVG-7 plan structurally, admits only REQUEST_CORE_PROCESS_CONTEXT whose intent is PAYMENT_OR_ACTIVATION (REGISTRATION_PROCESS remains AVG-9 on the other side of the same door), and inherits the CURRENT AVG-1 gate unwidened. The payment brief has no authority, no active flag and no attestation reference: it does not parse as an ActivationAttestation, and completeCoreActiveHandoff -- which this stage does not import, wrap or name -- remains the only route into HANDED_OFF_TO_ANISHA, reachable only by QUICKFURNO_CORE asserting active for the same prospect on a case already at AWAITING_CORE_ACTIVATION. The pre-handoff bridge into that boundary was deliberately not added, because Core exposes no prospect-facing fact that could justify entering it. This package holds no Supabase client, no QuickFurno import, no HTTP client and no credential, and creates no package order, payment, assignment, credit grant or activation. Aarohi's runtime remains PLANNED / DISABLED: no runtime, no outreach, no channel, no credential, no provider, no n8n, no Meta API, no Instagram transport, no WhatsApp, no persistence, no Core mutation and no execution of any kind. QuickFurno Core stays authoritative for registration, active/inactive/dormant/former status, previous-contact, duplicate and do-not-contact truth, vendor identity, paid/ACTIVE conversion and commercial truth; none of it may be inferred from model output, conversation text, a provider receipt, a delivery, memory, RAG or campaign state, and absent or ambiguous Core truth is a stop. AVG-11 adds AGGREGATE ANALYTICS and the admin READ surface, and its whole shape is the insistence that a workflow step is not a business outcome. The funnel vocabulary is CLOSED and has no REGISTERED, PAID, ACTIVE, CONVERTED or CONTACTED stage for a figure to reach; the stage an artifact counts for is DERIVED from which certified sibling parser accepts it, so an AVG-9 brief can only ever reach REGISTRATION_ASSISTANCE_PREPARED and an AVG-10 brief PAYMENT_FOLLOWUP_ASSISTANCE_PREPARED, and a value certified by no sibling or by two is refused rather than counted as other. A count is never separable from its authority: a closed distinction -- JARVIS_WORKFLOW_DERIVED, CORE_AUTHORITATIVE, AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE -- rides on every metric, stage-to-authority is a total map, and a caller supplies neither. Exactly one stage is Core-authoritative, and it is not counted from an artifact at all: it re-runs completeCoreActiveHandoff, unchanged and unwrapped, and counts only what AVG-1 itself confirms, so a provider receipt, a model inference, a conversation claim, Aarohi's own case state and a caller-supplied case already at HANDED_OFF_TO_ANISHA are each refused by the canonical function rather than by a second rule beside it. Nothing is transitioned and no case is mutated. UNKNOWN is not ZERO as a SHAPE rather than a rule: the metric is a discriminated union whose unavailable variant has no count key at all, so a mapper, a default or a client has nothing to read as zero, and whether a source was read is declared per authority class by the boundary that read it -- evidence of a class declared unobserved is a refusal, and an observed empty source is a genuine zero. No rate, ratio, percentage, conversion, trend, series, cohort or window exists and no function computes one, because across an authority boundary a numerator and a denominator are never known, compatible and same-cohort at once. Counting is deterministic: a stage counts DISTINCT PROSPECTS so duplicate evidence cannot inflate it, every check scans the whole input in a fixed order so shuffling cannot change a figure or a refusal, and one evidence identity presented for two prospects is refused rather than merged. A report carries stage tokens, an authority class and integers -- no prospect reference, case, draft, conversation, message, brief reference, Core lookup, package, amount, name, handle or destination. Pure contracts and pure functions over frozen values. Depends on zod. AVG-12 adds SCALE, EVALUATION and CONTROLLED AUTONOMY, and its whole shape is the insistence that evaluation is not authority. A closed corpus of adversarial PROBES drives the certified AVG-1..AVG-11 functions over fixtures built inside the module: a caller names probes and supplies no expectation, no severity and no result, because each probe's dimension and severity are total maps in the contract and each verdict comes from what a certified function actually returned. Every probe is mandatory, so a subset, a duplicate and an unknown token are each a named refusal rather than a smaller corpus; the report schema independently requires the whole corpus to be accounted for and refuses a passing outcome beside any failure at all, so a hand-built report cannot claim one and a critical failure cannot be averaged away by an absence of arithmetic. The red team covers the four substitute activation authorities, identity binding, stale and pre-causal evidence, sales ethics under instruction-shaped inbound text, suppression outranking commercial interest, the registration, payment and activation boundaries, the two deliberately-absent bridges, unknown-is-not-zero, determinism under reordering and duplication, aggregate data minimization, execution containment and rollout containment. SCALE means bounded algorithmic behaviour at maxima the SIBLING contracts declare -- accepted at the bound, refused whole above it with nothing truncated or sampled, and the whole input validated rather than a prefix -- reported as offline evaluation VOLUME with no throughput, concurrency, capacity, latency or production figure anywhere. CONTROLLED AUTONOMY reuses the repository's own ladder: L0_REASON and L1_READ are spelled as JAO-1, JAO-2 and JAO-4 spell them, and the one rung this stage adds only permits NAMING which already-certified offline preparation applies -- naming is not running, and every preparation named re-runs its own gate when it is called. The granted level is the lower of what was requested and what a DECLARED reason precedence permits; suppression, an existing relationship, unresolved Core truth and a failed corpus each restrict, a malformed envelope, an unbound observation, a non-canonical evaluation and a pre-causal decision each refuse outright, and nothing raises a level. There is no channel, destination, recipient, body, approval, execution intent, case transition or schedule field, so trying another channel and waiting out a refusal are unrepresentable rather than merely forbidden. Every level carries the SAME frozen posture, so the authority delta between the floor and the ceiling is empty by construction: business, contact, consent, suppression, approval, execution, send, Core-mutation, registration, payment, activation and rollout authority are each a schema-pinned literal false, as are every effect, every live connection and fullAarohiCertificationClaimed. No clock, no randomness, no seed, no store, no migration and no new dependency: the same injected input replays to byte-identical bytes. AVG-12 is the last OFFLINE IMPLEMENTATION stage and not the Aarohi certification, which remains a separate owner closeout; runtime stays PLANNED / DISABLED and production rollout stays OFF.
